title: Polaris Product Catalog & Orders
description: Polaris core: product catalog API, order API (placements, cancellations, quotes), MCP server tools used by the assistant, and order event delivery (outbox, shipment reports).

panels.title: Catalog requests
panels.description: Catalog API requests over the time range.

panels.title: Catalog availability
panels.description: Share of catalog requests that did not return 5xx over the time range.

panels.title: Catalog read latency ${quantile:text}
panels.description: Latency of catalog GET requests over the time range.

panels.title: Inventory updates
panels.description: Successful inventory updates (PUT .../inventory, 2xx) over the time range.

panels.title: Catalog routes over time range
panels.description: Per route over the selected time range. 4xx are client errors (validation, auth, not found); 5xx are server errors.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(products|categories).*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Orders placed (REST)
panels.description: New orders created through the REST API (POST /api/v1/orders → 201). Idempotent replays return 200 and are not counted. Orders the assistant places go through MCP; see the MCP row.

panels.title: Orders cancelled
panels.description: Successful cancellations (POST .../cancel → 2xx).

panels.title: Quotes
panels.description: Order quotes served (POST /api/v1/orders/quote → 2xx).

panels.title: Order placement rejected
panels.description: Share of POST /api/v1/orders answered with 4xx (validation, stock, price, idempotency conflict).

targets.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", method="POST", uri="/api/v1/orders", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", method="POST", uri="/api/v1/orders"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Order API availability
panels.description: Share of order/customer requests that did not return 5xx over the time range.

panels.title: Place order latency ${quantile:text}
panels.description: POST /api/v1/orders latency over the time range.

panels.title: Order writes by status
panels.description: Order commands per interval: place, cancel, claim and quote, split by HTTP status.

panels.title: Order routes over time range
panels.description: Per route over the selected time range. 4xx are client errors (validation, auth, not found); 5xx are server errors.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{exported_job="Polaris", uri=~"/api/v1/(orders|customers).*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: MCP server tools (/mcp, used by Polaris-Assistant; from Tempo span-metrics)
MCP tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls handled by the Polaris MCP server over the time range.

panels.title: MCP tool error rate
panels.description: Share of tool calls that failed: an exception or a tool result with isError=true (span attribute error=true).

panels.title: MCP tool latency ${quantile:text}
panels.description: Tool call latency across all tools over the time range.

panels.title: Orders placed (MCP)
panels.description: Successful place_order tool calls. Includes idempotent replays; the REST count above excludes them.

panels.title: MCP tool calls/s by tool
panels.description: Split by catalog/order category and failures.

panels.title: MCP tools over time range
panels.description: Per tool over the selected time range. Errors = exception or isError tool result.

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*"}[$__range]))), "tool", "$1", "span_name", "mcp.server.tool_call (.*)")

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*"}[$__range]))), "tool", "$1", "span_name", "mcp.server.tool_call (.*)")

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*"}[$__range]))), "tool", "$1", "span_name", "mcp.server.tool_call (.*)")

label_replace((sum by (span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*", error="true"}[$__range])) or sum by (span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (span_name, mcp_category) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="Polaris", span_name=~"mcp.server.tool_call .*"}[$__range])), "tool", "$1", "span_name", "mcp.server.tool_call (.*)")

panels.description: Order events written to the outbox but not yet handed to Kafka.

panels.title: Oldest pending event
panels.description: Age of the oldest outbox event still waiting for hand-off.

panels.title: Shipment reports applied
panels.description: Share of shipment reports from fulfilment partners that changed an order.

panels.title: Shipment consumer oldest record
panels.description: Age of the oldest in-flight record in the order.shipments consumer group.

panels.title: Outbox hand-off ${quantile:text} by event type
panels.description: Time from the relay picking an event to Kafka acknowledging it.

panels.title: Outbox delivery lag ${quantile:text} by event type
panels.description: Time from the order event occurring to it being published to Kafka.

panels.description: Reports consumed from the fulfilment partner topic. step/reason labels are currently dropped by the collector allow-list (metrics inventory B1).

panels.description: Oldest in-flight and blocked (retrying) record age per consumer group.
